```javascript
// ─── Componente principal ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
export default function VerticalTimeline({
  activeEventId  = null, 
  onEventClick   = null, 
  compact        = false}) {
  const lang = useDocLang();
  const [activeFilter, setActiveFilter] = useState('todos');
  const isEs = lang === 'es' || !['en','pt','fr','it','de'].includes(lang);

  // Filtrar eventos por categoría
  const filteredEvents = useMemo(() => {
    if (activeFilter === 'todos') return timelineEvents;
    return timelineEvents.filter(e =>
      (e.category || 'electrico') === activeFilter
    );
  }, [activeFilter]);

  // Progreso: porcentaje de eventos visibles
  const progressPct = Math.round((filteredEvents.length / timelineEvents.length) * 100);

  const handleKeyDown = (e, eventId) => {
    if ((e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') && onEventClick) {
      e.preventDefault();
      onEventClick(eventId);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className={styles.timelineScope}>
      {/* ── Filtros de categoría ─────────────────────────────── */}
      <div
        role="group"
        aria-label={isEs ? 'Filtrar por tipo de evento' : 'Filter by event type'}
        style={{
          display: 'flex', flexWrap: 'wrap', gap: '0.5rem',
          marginBottom: '1.5rem', alignItems: 'center',
        }}
      >
        {Object.entries(CATEGORIES).map(([key, cat]) => {
          const isActive = activeFilter === key;
          const label = cat[lang] || cat.es;
          return (
            <button
              key={key}
              onClick={() => setActiveFilter(key)}
              aria-pressed={isActive}
              style={{
                padding: '0.35rem 0.85rem',
                borderRadius: 20,
                border: `1px solid ${isActive ? cat.border : 'var(--vt-border)'}`,
                background: isActive ? cat.soft : 'transparent',
                color: isActive ? cat.color : 'var(--vt-text-muted)',
                cursor: 'pointer',
                fontFamily: 'monospace',
                fontSize: 12,
                fontWeight: isActive ? 700 : 400,
                transition: 'all 0.2s ease',
              }}
            >
              {label}
            </button>
          );
        })}

        {/* Barra de progreso */}
        <div style={{ marginLeft: 'auto', display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: '0.5rem' }}>
          <div style={{
            width: 120, height: 4,
            background: 'var(--vt-border)',
            borderRadius: 2, overflow: 'hidden',
          }}>
            <div style={{
              width: `${progressPct}%`, height: '100%',
              background: 'var(--vt-blue)',
              transition: 'width 0.3s ease',
            }} />
          </div>
          <span style={{ fontSize: 11, color: 'var(--vt-text-muted)', fontFamily: 'monospace' }}>
            {filteredEvents.length}/{timelineEvents.length}
          </span>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* ── Timeline ─────────────────────────────────────────── */}
      <div
        className={styles.timelineContainer}
        role="list"
        aria-label={isEs ? 'Línea de tiempo del apagón ibérico del 28-A' : '28-A blackout timeline'}
      >
        {filteredEvents.map((event, index) => {
          const alignmentClass = index % 2 === 0 ? styles.leftEvent : styles.rightEvent;

          let typeColor = 'var(--vt-blue)';
          let typeGlow = 'var(--vt-blue-glow)';

          if (event.type === 'warning') {
            typeColor = 'var(--vt-amber)';
            typeGlow = 'var(--vt-amber-glow)';
          }

          if (event.type === 'danger' || event.type === 'critical') {
            typeColor = 'var(--vt-red)';
            typeGlow = 'var(--vt-red-glow)';
          }

          if (event.type === 'success') {
            typeColor = 'var(--vt-green)';
            typeGlow = 'var(--vt-green-glow)';
          }

          const loc       = getLocalizedEvent(event, lang);
          const isActive  = activeEventId === event.id;
          const isClickable = typeof onEventClick === 'function';

          return (
            <div
              key={event.id}
              role="listitem"
              className={`${styles.timelineBlock} ${alignmentClass} ${isActive ? styles.activeEvent : ''}`}
              onClick={isClickable ? () => onEventClick(event.id) : undefined}
              onKeyDown={isClickable ? (e) => handleKeyDown(e, event.id) : undefined}
              tabIndex={isClickable ? 0 : undefined}
              aria-current={isActive ? 'true' : undefined}
              style={{ cursor: isClickable ? 'pointer' : 'default' }}
            >
              <div
                aria-hidden="true"
                className={`${styles.timelineDot} ${isActive ? styles.activeDot : ''}`}
                style={{
                  backgroundColor: typeColor,
                  boxShadow: `0 0 0 4px var(--vt-dot-ring), 0 0 0 8px ${typeGlow}`,
                }}
              />

              <div
                className={styles.timelineContent}
                style={{ borderTop: `4px solid ${typeColor}` }}
              >
                <div className={styles.timeBadge}>
                  {loc.dateStr} {event.time ? `• ${event.time}` : ''}
                </div>
                <h3 className={styles.eventTitle}>{loc.title}</h3>
                {!compact && (
                  <p className={styles.eventDesc}>{loc.desc}</p>
                )}
                {/* Badge de categoría */}
                {event.category && event.category !== 'electrico' && (
                  <span style={{
                    display: 'inline-block',
                    marginTop: 6,
                    padding: '0.15rem 0.5rem',
                    borderRadius: 10,
                    fontSize: 10,
                    fontFamily: 'monospace',
                    background: CATEGORIES[event.category]?.soft || 'var(--vt-bg-chip)',
                    color: CATEGORIES[event.category]?.color || 'var(--vt-text-muted)',
                    border: `1px solid ${CATEGORIES[event.category]?.border || 'var(--vt-border)'}`,
                    textTransform: 'uppercase',
                    letterSpacing: '0.06em',
                  }}>
                    {CATEGORIES[event.category]?.[lang] || CATEGORIES[event.category]?.es || event.category}
                  </span>
                )}
              </div>
            </div>
          );
        })}
      </div>

      {filteredEvents.length === 0 && (
        <p style={{
          textAlign: 'center',
          color: 'var(--vt-text-muted)',
          fontFamily: 'monospace',
          fontSize: 13,
        }}>
          {isEs ? 'No hay eventos en esta categoría.' : 'No events in this category.'}
        </p>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

```css
.timelineContainer {
  position: relative;
  max-width: 800px;
  margin: 3rem auto;
  padding: 1rem 0;
}

.timelineContainer::before {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  top: 0;
  bottom: 0;
  left: 50%;
  width: 4px;
  margin-left: -2px;
  background-color: var(--vt-line);
  border-radius: 4px;
}

.timelineBlock {
  position: relative;
  margin-bottom: 2.5rem;
  width: 100%;
  display: flex;
  justify-content: flex-start;
  align-items: center;
}

.timelineBlock.rightEvent {
  justify-content: flex-end;
}

.timelineDot {
  position: absolute;
  top: 50%;
  left: 50%;
  width: 20px;
  height: 20px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  margin-left: -10px;
  margin-top: -10px;
  z-index: 2;
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px var(--vt-dot-ring);
}

.timelineContent {
  width: 45%;
  background-color: var(--vt-bg-card);
  padding: 1.5rem;
  border-radius: 10px;
  border: 1px solid var(--vt-border);
  box-shadow: var(--vt-shadow);
  position: relative;
  transition:
    transform 0.3s ease,
    box-shadow 0.3s ease,
    background-color 0.3s ease,
    border-color 0.3s ease;
}

.timelineContent:hover {
  transform: translateY(-5px);
  background-color: var(--vt-bg-card-hover);
  border-color: var(--vt-border-strong);
  box-shadow: var(--vt-shadow-hover);
}

.leftEvent .timelineContent::before {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  top: 50%;
  right: -10px;
  margin-top: -10px;
  border-width: 10px 0 10px 10px;
  border-style: solid;
  border-color: transparent transparent transparent var(--vt-bg-card);
}

.rightEvent .timelineContent::before {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  top: 50%;
  left: -10px;
  margin-top: -10px;
  border-width: 10px 10px 10px 0;
  border-style: solid;
  border-color: transparent var(--vt-bg-card) transparent transparent;
}

.timeBadge {
  display: inline-block;
  background-color: var(--vt-bg-chip);
  color: var(--vt-text-secondary);
  border: 1px solid var(--vt-border);
  padding: 0.3rem 0.8rem;
  border-radius: 20px;
  font-size: 0.85rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  margin-bottom: 1rem;
}

.eventTitle {
  font-size: 1.25rem;
  margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
  color: var(--vt-text-primary);
  line-height: 1.3;
}

.eventDesc {
  font-size: 0.95rem;
  color: var(--vt-text-secondary);
  margin: 0;
  line-height: 1.5;
}

.activeEvent .timelineContent {
  transform: scale(1.03);
  box-shadow: var(--vt-shadow-hover);
  border-color: var(--vt-blue-border) !important;
  background-color: var(--vt-bg-card-hover);
}

.activeEvent .eventTitle {
  color: var(--vt-blue);
}

.activeDot {
  transform: scale(1.3);
  box-shadow:
    0 0 0 4px var(--vt-dot-ring),
    0 0 0 8px var(--vt-blue-soft),
    0 0 18px var(--vt-blue-glow) !important;
}

@media (max-width: 768px) {
  .timelineContainer::before {
    left: 20px;
  }

  .timelineBlock,
  .timelineBlock.rightEvent {
    justify-content: flex-end;
  }

  .timelineDot {
    left: 20px;
  }

  .timelineContent {
    width: calc(100% - 60px);
  }

  .leftEvent .timelineContent::before,
  .rightEvent .timelineContent::before {
    left: -10px;
    right: auto;
    border-width: 10px 10px 10px 0;
    border-color: transparent var(--vt-bg-card) transparent transparent;
  }
}
```

```javascript
import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { useColorMode } from '@docusaurus/theme-common';
import styles from './VulnerabilityRiskMatrix.module.css';

/* ─── Paleta ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
function getPalette(isDark) {
  return {
    bg:           isDark ? 'rgba(14,26,50,0.97)'    : 'rgba(255,252,245,0.97)',
    surface:      isDark ? 'rgba(20,36,64,0.92)'    : 'rgba(248,244,236,0.96)',
    border:       isDark ? 'rgba(190,209,230,0.18)' : 'rgba(58,49,35,0.14)',
    borderStrong: isDark ? 'rgba(190,209,230,0.32)' : 'rgba(58,49,35,0.26)',
    grid:         isDark ? 'rgba(190,209,230,0.08)' : 'rgba(58,49,35,0.07)',
    text1:        isDark ? '#f4f7fb'  : '#191814',
    text2:        isDark ? '#d6e0ee'  : '#3a3428',
    text3:        isDark ? '#aab9cc'  : '#6a5f52',
    main:         isDark ? '#83bdc2'  : '#145c63',
    mainSoft:     isDark ? 'rgba(131,189,194,0.16)' : 'rgba(20,92,99,0.10)',
    amber:        isDark ? '#d4a84e'  : '#8a6030',
    amberSoft:    isDark ? 'rgba(212,168,78,0.16)'  : 'rgba(138,96,48,0.10)',
    red:          isDark ? '#d86a64'  : '#8c2e2a',
    redSoft:      isDark ? 'rgba(216,106,100,0.16)' : 'rgba(140,46,42,0.09)',
    zoneHH:       isDark ? 'rgba(216,106,100,0.07)' : 'rgba(140,46,42,0.05)',
    zoneMid:      isDark ? 'rgba(212,168,78,0.05)'  : 'rgba(138,96,48,0.04)',
  };
}

/* ─── Datos ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
// x: 0–1 incidencia (izq=puntual → der=masiva)
// y: 0–1 severidad  (abajo=reversible → arriba=letal)
// r: radio relativo del punto (codifica magnitud de población)
const POINTS = [
  {
    id: 'co',
    label: 'CO / incendios',
    x: 0.10, y: 0.90, r: 1.0,
    color: 'red',
    grupo: 'Intoxicaciones CO e incendios domésticos',
    severidad: 'Letal · irreversible',
    incidencia: 'Muy puntual',
    evidencia: '3 fallecidos por monóxido de carbono (Taboadela, Ourense) y 1 calcinado por vela (Carabanchel, Madrid). Comportamiento de riesgo derivado de la ausencia de electricidad.',
    reforma: 'Sin reforma estructural activada. Evidencian déficit en comunicación preventiva de emergencias.',
    fuente: 'Guardia Civil / Instituto de Medicina Legal de Galicia',
  },
  {
    id: 'electrodep',
    label: 'Electrodependientes',
    x: 0.20, y: 0.86, r: 1.2,
    color: 'red',
    grupo: 'Pacientes electrodependientes domiciliarios',
    severidad: 'Letal · irreversible',
    incidencia: 'Individual-puntual',
    evidencia: 'Fallecimiento verificado en Cacém (Portugal, 15:17h) al agotarse la batería del respirador. Al menos 1 muerte adicional en Valencia (concentrador de oxígeno). INEM no llegó a tiempo por colapso vial y telecomunicaciones.',
    reforma: 'Propuesta de censo digital redundante de electrodependientes — sin fecha verificada.',
    fuente: 'IGAS / Auditoría parlamentaria Portugal',
  },
  {
    id: 'hospitales',
    label: 'Hospitales',
    x: 0.40, y: 0.75, r: 1.6,
    color: 'amber',
    grupo: 'Hospitales sin reserva suficiente de gasóleo',
    severidad: 'Muy alta · riesgo sistémico',
    incidencia: 'Media — todos los centros',
    evidencia: 'A las 2 horas del apagón, varios hospitales portugueses estaban prácticamente sin combustible para generadores. Ninguna muerte hospitalaria verificada — el margen fue estrecho.',
    reforma: 'Revisión de protocolos de combustible hospitalario + CAPEX en generadores de mayor autonomía.',
    fuente: 'ANEPC / Comisión parlamentaria Portugal',
  },
  {
    id: 'dialisis',
    label: 'Diálisis',
    x: 0.32, y: 0.63, r: 1.3,
    color: 'amber',
    grupo: 'Pacientes de hemodiálisis domiciliaria',
    severidad: 'Alta · riesgo metabólico agudo',
    incidencia: 'Colectivo específico',
    evidencia: 'Tratamientos reprogramados a la madrugada. Sin letalidades directas. Caso documentado: familia conectó concentrador a batería de furgoneta para mantener con vida a un niño.',
    reforma: 'Sin reforma específica activada para este colectivo.',
    fuente: 'Federación ALCER / Documentación asistencial post-28A',
  },
  {
    id: 'sordos',
    label: 'Comunidad sorda',
    x: 0.58, y: 0.58, r: 1.7,
    color: 'amber',
    grupo: 'Personas sordas — aislamiento informativo total',
    severidad: 'Alta · exclusión de emergencia',
    incidencia: 'Media-alta · ~1M personas',
    evidencia: 'Al caer TDT e internet, la radio FM fue el único canal oficial — completamente inaccesible. Sin intérpretes ni formato visual. Sin directrices sobre evacuar o confinarse.',
    reforma: 'Propuesta de canales visuales redundantes en protocolos de emergencia (en tramitación).',
    fuente: 'CNSE — Confederación Estatal de Personas Sordas',
  },
  {
    id: 'ascensores',
    label: 'Atrapados en ascensores',
    x: 0.80, y: 0.35, r: 2.0,
    color: 'main',
    grupo: 'Personas atrapadas en ascensores',
    severidad: 'Media · distress agudo reversible',
    incidencia: 'Alta · 400+ Portugal; 44 solo en Bizkaia en 2h',
    evidencia: 'ANEPC documentó más de 400 incidentes simultáneos en Portugal. En Bizkaia, 44 rescates en las primeras 2 horas. Drenó recursos de emergencia necesarios para otras contingencias.',
    reforma: 'Sin reforma estructural activada.',
    fuente: 'ANEPC Portugal / Bomberos Diputación Foral de Bizkaia',
  },
];

const BASE_R = 10; // radio base en px del SVG

/* ─── SVG Matriz ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
function MatrixSVG({ p, activeId, onSelect }) {
  const W = 380, H = 320;
  const PAD = { top: 16, right: 16, bottom: 44, left: 96 };
  const IW = W - PAD.left - PAD.right;
  const IH = H - PAD.top - PAD.bottom;

  function pos(x, y) {
    return { sx: PAD.left + x * IW, sy: PAD.top + (1 - y) * IH };
  }

  const colorMap = { red: p.red, amber: p.amber, main: p.main };
  const softMap  = { red: p.redSoft, amber: p.amberSoft, main: p.mainSoft };

  const yLabels = [
    { v: 0.88, t: 'Letal' },
    { v: 0.65, t: 'Muy alta' },
    { v: 0.42, t: 'Alta' },
    { v: 0.18, t: 'Media' },
  ];
  const xLabels = [
    { v: 0.12, t: 'Puntual' },
    { v: 0.40, t: 'Colectivo' },
    { v: 0.68, t: 'Franja' },
    { v: 0.90, t: 'Masiva' },
  ];

  return (
    <svg
      viewBox={`0 0 ${W} ${H}`}
      width="100%"
      height="auto"
      role="img"
      aria-label="Matriz de impacto: severidad en eje Y, incidencia poblacional en eje X"
      style={{ display: 'block' }}
    >
      {/* Zona crítica fondo */}
      <rect
        x={PAD.left} y={PAD.top}
        width={IW * 0.5} height={IH * 0.55}
        fill={p.zoneHH}
      />
      <text
        x={PAD.left + IW * 0.25}
        y={PAD.top + 10}
        textAnchor="middle"
        fontSize={7.5}
        fontWeight={700}
        fill={p.red}
        opacity={0.45}
        fontFamily="'IBM Plex Mono', monospace"
        letterSpacing="0.1em"
      >
        ZONA CRÍTICA
      </text>

      {/* Grid */}
      {[0.25, 0.5, 0.75].map(v => (
        <g key={v}>
          <line x1={PAD.left} y1={PAD.top + (1-v)*IH} x2={PAD.left+IW} y2={PAD.top+(1-v)*IH}
            stroke={p.grid} strokeWidth={1} />
          <line x1={PAD.left+v*IW} y1={PAD.top} x2={PAD.left+v*IW} y2={PAD.top+IH}
            stroke={p.grid} strokeWidth={1} />
        </g>
      ))}

      {/* Ejes */}
      <line x1={PAD.left} y1={PAD.top} x2={PAD.left} y2={PAD.top+IH}
        stroke={p.borderStrong} strokeWidth={1.5} />
      <line x1={PAD.left} y1={PAD.top+IH} x2={PAD.left+IW} y2={PAD.top+IH}
        stroke={p.borderStrong} strokeWidth={1.5} />

      {/* Título eje Y */}
      <text
        x={11} y={PAD.top + IH/2}
        textAnchor="middle" fontSize={7.5} fill={p.text3}
        fontFamily="'IBM Plex Mono', monospace"
        letterSpacing="0.05em"
        transform={`rotate(-90,11,${PAD.top+IH/2})`}
      >SEVERIDAD →</text>

      {/* Título eje X */}
      <text
        x={PAD.left + IW/2} y={H - 4}
        textAnchor="middle" fontSize={7.5} fill={p.text3}
        fontFamily="'IBM Plex Mono', monospace"
        letterSpacing="0.05em"
      >INCIDENCIA POBLACIONAL →</text>

      {/* Etiquetas Y */}
      {yLabels.map(({ v, t }) => {
        const { sy } = pos(0, v);
        return (
          <text key={t} x={PAD.left - 7} y={sy + 3.5}
            textAnchor="end" fontSize={8} fill={p.text3}
            fontFamily="'IBM Plex Mono', monospace">{t}</text>
        );
      })}

      {/* Etiquetas X */}
      {xLabels.map(({ v, t }) => {
        const { sx } = pos(v, 0);
        return (
          <text key={t} x={sx} y={PAD.top + IH + 13}
            textAnchor="middle" fontSize={8} fill={p.text3}
            fontFamily="'IBM Plex Mono', monospace">{t}</text>
        );
      })}

      {/* Puntos */}
      {POINTS.map(pt => {
        const { sx, sy } = pos(pt.x, pt.y);
        const isActive = activeId === pt.id;
        const color = colorMap[pt.color];
        const soft  = softMap[pt.color];
        const r = BASE_R * pt.r;

        return (
          <g
            key={pt.id}
            onClick={() => onSelect(pt.id)}
            style={{ cursor: 'pointer' }}
            role="button"
            aria-label={pt.grupo}
            aria-pressed={isActive}
            tabIndex={0}
            onKeyDown={e => (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') && onSelect(pt.id)}
          >
            {isActive && (
              <circle cx={sx} cy={sy} r={r + 7}
                fill={soft} opacity={0.7} />
            )}
            <circle
              cx={sx} cy={sy} r={r}
              fill={isActive ? color : soft}
              stroke={color}
              strokeWidth={isActive ? 2.5 : 1.8}
              opacity={isActive ? 1 : 0.82}
            />
            {/* Etiqueta bajo el punto — solo si no activo */}
            {!isActive && (
              <text
                x={sx} y={sy + r + 9}
                textAnchor="middle" fontSize={7.5} fontWeight={600}
                fill={color} fontFamily="'IBM Plex Mono', monospace"
                style={{ pointerEvents: 'none' }}
              >
                {pt.label}
              </text>
            )}
            {/* Cuando activo: etiqueta dentro */}
            {isActive && (
              <text
                x={sx} y={sy + 3.5}
                textAnchor="middle" fontSize={8} fontWeight={700}
                fill={isActive ? '#fff' : color}
                fontFamily="'IBM Plex Mono', monospace"
                style={{ pointerEvents: 'none' }}
              >
                ●
              </text>
            )}
          </g>
        );
      })}
    </svg>
  );
}

/* ─── Tarjeta de detalle (lateral compacta) ──────────────────────────────── */
function DetailCard({ point, p }) {
  if (!point) {
    return (
      <div className={styles.cardEmpty} style={{ borderColor: p.border, color: p.text3 }}>
        <span className={styles.cardEmptyArrow}>←</span>
        <span>Selecciona un punto para ver la evidencia</span>
      </div>
    );
  }

  const colorMap = { red: p.red, amber: p.amber, main: p.main };
  const softMap  = { red: p.redSoft, amber: p.amberSoft, main: p.mainSoft };
  const color = colorMap[point.color];
  const soft  = softMap[point.color];

  return (
    <div
      className={styles.card}
      style={{ background: p.surface, borderColor: color }}
      role="region"
      aria-label={`Detalle: ${point.grupo}`}
    >
      {/* Título */}
      <div className={styles.cardTitle} style={{ color }}>
        {point.grupo}
      </div>

      {/* Badges */}
      <div className={styles.cardBadges}>
        <span className={styles.badge} style={{ background: soft, color }}>
          {point.severidad}
        </span>
        <span className={styles.badge} style={{ background: p.mainSoft, color: p.main }}>
          {point.incidencia}
        </span>
      </div>

      {/* Filas de datos */}
      <div className={styles.cardRows}>
        <div className={styles.cardRow}>
          <span className={styles.cardRowKey} style={{ color: p.text3 }}>Evidencia</span>
          <span className={styles.cardRowVal} style={{ color: p.text2 }}>{point.evidencia}</span>
        </div>
        <div className={styles.cardRow}>
          <span className={styles.cardRowKey} style={{ color: p.text3 }}>Reforma</span>
          <span className={styles.cardRowVal} style={{ color: p.text2 }}>{point.reforma}</span>
        </div>
        <div className={styles.cardRow}>
          <span className={styles.cardRowKey} style={{ color: p.text3 }}>Fuente</span>
          <span className={styles.cardRowVal} style={{ color: p.text3, fontStyle: 'italic' }}>{point.fuente}</span>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

/* ─── Main ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
export default function VulnerabilityRiskMatrix() {
  const { colorMode } = useColorMode();
  const isDark = colorMode === 'dark';
  const p = getPalette(isDark);
  const [activeId, setActiveId] = useState('electrodep');

  const activePoint = POINTS.find(pt => pt.id === activeId) || null;
  const toggle = id => setActiveId(prev => prev === id ? null : id);

  return (
    <figure className={styles.figure} style={{ background: p.bg, borderColor: p.border }}>

      {/* Header compacto */}
      <div className={styles.header}>
        <span className={styles.kicker} style={{ color: p.main }}>Impacto social · 28-A</span>
        <h3 className={styles.title} style={{ color: p.text1 }}>
          Impacto asimétrico sobre poblaciones vulnerables
        </h3>
      </div>

      {/* Layout dos columnas */}
      <div className={styles.layout}>
        {/* Izquierda: matriz */}
        <div className={styles.matrixCol}>
          <MatrixSVG p={p} activeId={activeId} onSelect={toggle} />

          {/* Leyenda bajo la matriz */}
          <div className={styles.legend}>
            {[
              { color: p.red,   soft: p.redSoft,   label: 'Letal / irreversible' },
              { color: p.amber, soft: p.amberSoft,  label: 'Grave / sistémica' },
              { color: p.main,  soft: p.mainSoft,   label: 'Media / reversible' },
            ].map(({ color, soft, label }) => (
              <div key={label} className={styles.legendItem}>
                <span className={styles.legendDot}
                  style={{ background: soft, border: `1.5px solid ${color}` }} />
                <span style={{ color: p.text3 }}>{label}</span>
              </div>
            ))}
            <div className={styles.legendItem} style={{ marginLeft: 'auto' }}>
              <span className={styles.legendNote} style={{ color: p.text3 }}>
                Tamaño ≈ población afectada
              </span>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Derecha: tarjeta de detalle */}
        <div className={styles.detailCol}>
          <DetailCard point={activePoint} p={p} />
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Nota metodológica — una línea */}
      <p className={styles.methodNote} style={{ color: p.text3, borderTopColor: p.border }}>
        <strong style={{ color: p.amber }}>Nota:</strong>{' '}
        Posiciones cualitativas basadas en evidencia documental verificada;
        la incidencia expresa órdenes de magnitud, no censos exactos.
        Los 8 fallecimientos verificados representan el mínimo documentado.
      </p>

    </figure>
  );
}
```

```css
/* ─── VulnerabilityRiskMatrix v2 ─────────────────────────────────────────────
   Prefix: --vrm-
   Estructura: header compacto + dos columnas (matriz | tarjeta) + nota
   ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

.figure {
  margin: 2.5rem 0;
  padding: 1.25rem 1.4rem 1rem;
  border: 1px solid;
  border-radius: 10px;
  box-shadow: 0 4px 22px rgba(58, 49, 35, 0.08);
  font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', 'Courier New', monospace;
}

html[data-theme='dark'] .figure {
  box-shadow: 0 4px 28px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.32);
}

/* Blindaje SVG */
.figure svg {
  border-radius: 0 !important;
  box-shadow: none !important;
  transform: none !important;
  margin: 0 !important;
  transition: none !important;
  display: block;
}
.figure svg:hover {
  transform: none !important;
  box-shadow: none !important;
}

/* ─── Header ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
.header {
  margin-bottom: 0.9rem;
}

.kicker {
  display: block;
  font-size: 0.60rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.12em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  margin-bottom: 0.25rem;
}

.title {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 0.92rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  line-height: 1.3;
  letter-spacing: -0.01em;
}

/* ─── Layout dos columnas ────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
.layout {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr 280px;
  gap: 1rem;
  align-items: start;
  margin-bottom: 0.75rem;
}

@media (max-width: 740px) {
  .layout {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }
}

/* ─── Columna izquierda ──────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
.matrixCol {
  min-width: 0;
}

/* ─── Leyenda ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
.legend {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.35rem 0.9rem;
  margin-top: 0.5rem;
}

.legendItem {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.3rem;
  font-size: 0.64rem;
}

.legendDot {
  width: 10px;
  height: 10px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

.legendNote {
  font-size: 0.60rem;
  font-style: italic;
}

/* ─── Columna derecha: tarjeta ───────────────────────────────────────────── */
.detailCol {
  min-width: 0;
}

/* Estado vacío */
.cardEmpty {
  border: 1px dashed;
  border-radius: 8px;
  padding: 1.25rem 0.9rem;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.5rem;
  font-size: 0.68rem;
  text-align: center;
  min-height: 120px;
  justify-content: center;
  line-height: 1.5;
}

.cardEmptyArrow {
  font-size: 1.1rem;
  opacity: 0.4;
}

/* Tarjeta activa */
.card {
  border: 1px solid;
  border-radius: 8px;
  overflow: hidden;
  animation: vrmIn 0.16s ease;
}

@keyframes vrmIn {
  from { opacity: 0; transform: translateX(5px); }
  to   { opacity: 1; transform: translateX(0); }
}

.cardTitle {
  padding: 0.65rem 0.85rem 0.5rem;
  font-size: 0.74rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  line-height: 1.35;
  border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.06);
}

html[data-theme='dark'] .cardTitle {
  border-bottom-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.06);
}

.cardBadges {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 0.25rem;
  padding: 0.5rem 0.85rem;
}

.badge {
  font-size: 0.57rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.04em;
  padding: 0.15rem 0.45rem;
  border-radius: 3px;
}

/* Filas de datos */
.cardRows {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  padding: 0.5rem 0.85rem 0.75rem;
  gap: 0.55rem;
}

.cardRow {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 0.15rem;
}

.cardRowKey {
  font-size: 0.57rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.08em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

.cardRowVal {
  font-size: 0.67rem;
  line-height: 1.55;
}

/* ─── Nota metodológica ──────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
.methodNote {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 0.64rem;
  line-height: 1.55;
  padding-top: 0.65rem;
  border-top: 1px solid;
}

/* ─── Responsive móvil ───────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
@media (max-width: 480px) {
  .figure  { padding: 1rem 0.85rem 0.9rem; }
  .title   { font-size: 0.84rem; }
  .legend  { flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; gap: 0.3rem; }
  .cardEmpty { min-height: 80px; }
}
```

```css
/* Annex System — Common CSS Module
   Unified visual language for all conceptual annexes.
   Light & dark mode support via CSS variables
   Responsive design for desktop, tablet, mobile
*/

.layout {
  --annex-bg: transparent;
  --annex-surface: rgba(255, 252, 245, 0.84);
  --annex-text-1: #191814;
  --annex-text-2: #4a4338;
  --annex-text-3: #7a7062;
  --annex-border: rgba(62, 52, 38, 0.14);
  --annex-accent: #145c63;
  --annex-accent-light: #2d8a91;
  --annex-subtle-bg: rgba(20, 92, 99, 0.04);
}

html[data-theme='dark'] .layout {
  --annex-bg: transparent;
  --annex-surface: rgba(7, 19, 38, 0.62);
  --annex-text-1: #f4f7fb;
  --annex-text-2: #c7d2e3;
  --annex-text-3: #91a4bc;
  --annex-border: rgba(156, 180, 210, 0.18);
  --annex-accent: #83bdc2;
  --annex-accent-light: #a6d8dd;
  --annex-subtle-bg: rgba(131, 189, 194, 0.05);
}

.layout {
  background-color: var(--annex-bg);
  color: var(--annex-text-1);
  font-family: 'Inter', system-ui, sans-serif;
  line-height: 1.6;
  border-radius: 8px;
  padding: clamp(1.5rem, 4vw, 2rem);
  margin: 1.5rem 0;
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
/* VARIANTE WIDE — solo para anexos conceptuales I–IX             */
/* Comportamiento híbrido:                                        */
/* - Por defecto (sidebar abierto): ancho normal 100%             */
/* - Sidebar oculto: breakout a pantalla completa (94vw)          */
/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

:global(html:has(.layoutWide) .theme-doc-toc-desktop),
:global(html:has(.layoutWide) .col--3) {
  display: none !important;
}

:global(html:has(.layoutWide) .col--9) {
  flex: 0 0 100% !important;
  max-width: 100% !important;
}

.layoutWide {
  /* Tamaño estándar por defecto (compactado con el sidebar) */
  width: 100%;
  transition: width 0.3s ease, margin 0.3s ease, transform 0.3s ease;
}

/* Cuando Docusaurus oculta el sidebar (clase controlada por React) */
.layoutWide.isSidebarHidden {
  position: relative;
  left: 50%;
  transform: translateX(-50%);
  width: 94vw;
  max-width: 1400px;
}

@media (max-width: 996px) {
  /* En tablet/móvil, Docusaurus nativamente oculta el sidebar lateral */
  .layoutWide {
    position: relative;
    left: 50%;
    transform: translateX(-50%);
    width: 96vw;
    max-width: 100%;
  }
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
/* HEADER SECTION */
/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

.header {
  margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--annex-border);
  padding-bottom: 1.2rem;
  text-align: left;
}

.kicker {
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.12em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--annex-accent);
  margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
  display: block;
}

.title {
  font-size: clamp(1.6rem, 5vw, 2.2rem);
  font-weight: 800;
  color: var(--annex-text-1);
  margin: 0.5rem 0 1rem;
  letter-spacing: -0.02em;
  line-height: 1.15;
}

.description {
  font-size: 1rem;
  color: var(--annex-text-2);
  max-width: 680px;
  line-height: 1.7;
  margin: 0.75rem 0;
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
/* METADATA CHIPS */
/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

.metaContainer {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 0.75rem;
  margin-top: 1.25rem;
  margin-bottom: 0;
}

.metaChip {
  display: inline-flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  padding: 0.4rem 0.8rem;
  background-color: var(--annex-surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--annex-border);
  border-radius: 6px;
  font-size: 0.85rem;
}

.metaChipLabel {
  font-weight: 600;
  color: var(--annex-text-3);
  font-size: 0.7rem;
  letter-spacing: 0.08em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  margin-bottom: 0.25rem;
}

.metaChipValue {
  color: var(--annex-text-1);
  font-weight: 500;
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
/* CONTENT AREA */
/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

.content {
  margin-top: 1.5rem;
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
/* ANNEX SECTION */
/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

.section {
  margin-bottom: 2.5rem;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--annex-border);
  padding-bottom: 2rem;
}

.section:last-child {
  border-bottom: none;
  margin-bottom: 0;
  padding-bottom: 0;
}

.sectionDetails {
  /* Native <details> styling */
}

.sectionDetails[open] .sectionSummary {
  color: var(--annex-accent);
}

.sectionDetails[open] .sectionSummary .sectionTitle {
  color: var(--annex-accent);
}

.sectionSummary {
  cursor: pointer;
  user-select: none;
  list-style: none;
  padding: 1rem;
  margin: -1rem -1rem 0 -1rem;
  border-radius: 6px;
  transition: all 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
  color: var(--annex-text-1);
}

.sectionSummary:hover {
  background-color: var(--annex-subtle-bg);
}

.sectionSummary:focus {
  outline: 2px solid var(--annex-accent);
  outline-offset: 2px;
}

.sectionSummary::-webkit-details-marker {
  display: none;
}

.sectionEyebrow {
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.1em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--annex-text-3);
  display: block;
  margin-bottom: 0.4rem;
}

.sectionTitle {
  font-size: clamp(1.25rem, 4vw, 1.6rem);
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--annex-text-1);
  margin: 0.5rem 0;
  letter-spacing: -0.01em;
}

.sectionDescription {
  font-size: 0.95rem;
  color: var(--annex-text-2);
  margin-top: 0.5rem;
  line-height: 1.7;
}

.sectionContent {
  margin-top: 1.5rem;
  padding-left: 1rem;
  border-left: 3px solid var(--annex-subtle-bg);
  overflow-x: auto;
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
/* METHOD NOTE / DATA TYPE BADGE */
/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

.methodNote {
  display: block;
  padding: 0.65rem 1rem;
  margin: 0.75rem 0;
  border-radius: 6px;
  font-size: 0.8rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  line-height: 1.55;
  border: 1px solid;
}

/* Data type variants */

.methodNote.historico {
  background-color: rgba(20, 92, 99, 0.08);
  border-color: var(--annex-border);
  color: var(--annex-text-1);
}

html[data-theme='dark'] .methodNote.historico {
  background-color: rgba(131, 189, 194, 0.08);
  border-color: rgba(131, 189, 194, 0.25);
}

.methodNote.vivo {
  background-color: rgba(212, 163, 115, 0.08);
  border-color: rgba(212, 163, 115, 0.25);
  color: var(--annex-text-1);
}

html[data-theme='dark'] .methodNote.vivo {
  background-color: rgba(230, 180, 92, 0.08);
  border-color: rgba(230, 180, 92, 0.25);
}

.methodNote.estimacion {
  background-color: rgba(212, 163, 115, 0.06);
  border-color: var(--annex-border);
  color: var(--annex-text-2);
}

html[data-theme='dark'] .methodNote.estimacion {
  background-color: rgba(230, 180, 92, 0.06);
  border-color: rgba(230, 180, 92, 0.15);
}

.methodNote.reconstruccion {
  background-color: rgba(139, 38, 53, 0.06);
  border-color: var(--annex-border);
  color: var(--annex-text-1);
}

html[data-theme='dark'] .methodNote.reconstruccion {
  background-color: rgba(217, 135, 152, 0.06);
  border-color: rgba(217, 135, 152, 0.15);
}

.methodNote.modeloDidactico {
  background-color: rgba(20, 92, 99, 0.05);
  border-color: var(--annex-border);
  color: var(--annex-text-2);
}

html[data-theme='dark'] .methodNote.modeloDidactico {
  background-color: rgba(131, 189, 194, 0.05);
  border-color: rgba(131, 189, 194, 0.15);
}

.methodNote.ilustracionConceptual {
  background-color: rgba(78, 107, 79, 0.06);
  border-color: var(--annex-border);
  color: var(--annex-text-2);
}

html[data-theme='dark'] .methodNote.ilustracionConceptual {
  background-color: rgba(78, 107, 79, 0.06);
  border-color: rgba(78, 107, 79, 0.15);
}

.methodNote.cuestionAbierta {
  background-color: rgba(212, 163, 115, 0.05);
  border-color: var(--annex-border);
  color: var(--annex-text-2);
  font-style: italic;
}

html[data-theme='dark'] .methodNote.cuestionAbierta {
  background-color: rgba(230, 180, 92, 0.05);
  border-color: rgba(230, 180, 92, 0.12);
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
/* RESPONSIVE */
/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

@media (max-width: 768px) {
  .layout {
    padding: clamp(1rem, 4vw, 1.5rem);
    margin: 1.5rem 0;
  }

  .metaContainer {
    gap: 0.5rem;
  }

  .metaChip {
    padding: 0.5rem 0.75rem;
    font-size: 0.8rem;
  }

  .sectionContent {
    padding-left: 0.75rem;
    border-left-width: 2px;
  }

  .title {
    font-size: clamp(1.4rem, 4vw, 1.8rem);
  }

  .sectionTitle {
    font-size: clamp(1.15rem, 3vw, 1.4rem);
  }
}

@media (max-width: 480px) {
  .layout {
    padding: 1rem;
  }

  .header {
    padding-bottom: 1rem;
    margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
  }

  .metaChip {
    flex: 1 1 calc(50% - 0.25rem);
    min-width: 140px;
  }

  .sectionSummary {
    padding: 0.75rem;
    margin: -0.75rem -0.75rem 0 -0.75rem;
  }

  .sectionContent {
    padding-left: 0.5rem;
  }
}

/* ============================================================
   AnnexTabs
   ============================================================ */

.tabsWrapper {
  margin-top: 1.5rem;
  margin-bottom: 1rem;
}

.tabList {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 0.5rem;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--annex-border);
  margin-bottom: 1.25rem;
}

.tabButton {
  margin-bottom: -1px;
  padding: 0.55rem 1.1rem;
  border: 1px solid var(--annex-border);
  border-bottom-color: transparent;
  border-radius: 8px 8px 0 0;
  background: transparent;
  color: var(--annex-text-2, #4b5563);
  font-family: var(--ifm-font-family-base, system-ui, sans-serif);
  font-size: 0.875rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition:
    color 0.15s ease,
    border-color 0.15s ease,
    background 0.15s ease;
}

.tabButton:hover {
  color: var(--annex-accent);
  border-color: var(--annex-accent);
  background: rgba(20, 92, 99, 0.06);
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--annex-accent) 6%, transparent);
}

.tabButtonActive {
  color: var(--annex-accent);
  border-color: var(--annex-accent);
  border-bottom-color: var(--annex-surface);
  background: var(--annex-surface);
  font-weight: 700;
}

.tabButton:focus-visible {
  outline: 2px solid var(--annex-accent);
  outline-offset: 2px;
}

.tabPanel {
  min-width: 0;
}

html[data-theme='dark'] .tabButton {
  color: var(--annex-text-2, #cbd5e1);
}

html[data-theme='dark'] .tabButton:hover {
  background: rgba(131, 189, 194, 0.08);
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--annex-accent) 10%, transparent);
}

html[data-theme='dark'] .tabButtonActive {
  border-bottom-color: var(--annex-surface);
  background: var(--annex-surface);
}
```

```javascript
  return (
    <div className={styles.container}>
      <h4 className={styles.title}>Anexos Relacionados</h4>
      <ul className={styles.list}>
        {links.map((link, idx) => (
          <li key={idx} className={styles.item}>
            <Link to={link.to} className={styles.link}>
              <span>{link.label}</span>
              <span className={styles.arrow}>→</span>
            </Link>
          </li>
        ))}
      </ul>
    </div>
  );
}
```

--- FILE: src/components/annex/AnnexEvidence.jsx ---
```javascript
import React, { useMemo } from 'react';
import styles from './AnnexEvidence.module.css';

// Data sources
import { imageGalleryData } from '../../data/imageGalleryData';
import forensicCategoriesEs from '../../../static/data/processed/forensic_categories.json';
import forensicCategoriesEn from '../../../static/data/processed/forensic_categories_en.json';
import forensicCategoriesDe from '../../../static/data/processed/forensic_categories_de.json';
import forensicCategoriesZh from '../../../static/data/processed/forensic_categories_zh-Hans.json';

import { graphicsData, getGraphicData } from '../InteractiveGraphicsGalleryBase';
import { CHARTS as chartsEs } from '../../data/forensicCharts';
import { CHARTS as chartsEn } from '../../data/forensicCharts_en';
import { CHARTS as chartsDe } from '../../data/forensicCharts_de';
import { CHARTS as chartsPt } from '../../data/forensicCharts_pt';
import { CHARTS as chartsFr } from '../../data/forensicCharts_fr';
import { CHARTS as chartsIt } from '../../data/forensicCharts_it';
import { useDocLang } from '@site/src/hooks/useDocLang';
import AnnexEvidenceViewer from './AnnexEvidenceViewer';

const getCharts = (lang) => {
  switch (lang) {
    case 'en': return chartsEn;
    case 'de': return chartsDe;
    case 'pt': return chartsPt;
    case 'fr': return chartsFr;
    case 'it': return chartsIt;
    case 'zh-Hans': return chartsEn;
    default: return chartsEs;
  }
};

const getForensicCategories = (lang) => {
  switch (lang) {
    case 'en': return forensicCategoriesEn;
    case 'de': return forensicCategoriesDe;
    case 'zh-Hans': return forensicCategoriesZh;
    default: return forensicCategoriesEs;
  }
};

export default function AnnexEvidence({ type, id, level = 2 }) {
  const lang = useDocLang();

  const getChips = (l) => {
    switch (l) {
      case 'en': return {
        1: { symbol: '●', label: 'Key evidence' },
        2: { symbol: '◆', label: 'Supporting evidence' },
      };
      case 'de': return {
        1: { symbol: '●', label: 'Hauptbeweis' },
        2: { symbol: '◆', label: 'Unterstützender Nachweis' },
      };
      case 'zh-Hans': return {
        1: { symbol: '●', label: '核心证据' },
        2: { symbol: '◆', label: '支持性证据' },
      };
      default: return {
        1: { symbol: '●', label: 'Evidencia nuclear' },
        2: { symbol: '◆', label: 'Evidencia de apoyo' },
      };
    }
  };

  const CHIPS = getChips(lang);

  // Find item based on type and id
  const item = useMemo(() => {
    if (!id) return null;

    if (type === 'figure') {
      const allFigures = imageGalleryData?.chapters
        ? imageGalleryData.chapters.flatMap((chap) => chap.images || [])
        : (Array.isArray(imageGalleryData) ? imageGalleryData : []);
      
      // Match by substring in src or by id directly if available
      return allFigures.find(
        (fig) =>
          fig.id === id || 
          (fig.src && fig.src.toLowerCase().includes(id.toLowerCase()))
      );
    }

    if (type === 'table') {
      const cats = getForensicCategories(lang);
      if (!cats || !cats.categories) return null;
      const allTables = cats.categories.flatMap((cat) => cat.tables || []);
      return allTables.find((table) => table.id === id);
    }

    if (type === 'interactive') {
      const graphic = (graphicsData || []).find((g) => g.id === id);
      if (!graphic) return null;
      const data = getGraphicData(graphic.id, lang);
      return {
        ...graphic,
        title: data ? data.title : graphic.id,
        description: data ? data.desc : `Interactivo: ${graphic.id}`,
      };
    }

    if (type === 'chart') {
      return (getCharts(lang) || []).find((chart) => chart.id === id);
    }

    return null;
  }, [type, id, lang]);

  if (!item) {
    const getErrorMsg = (l, t, i) => {
      switch (l) {
        case 'en': return `[AnnexEvidence Error] No element of type "${t}" found with ID "${i}"`;
        case 'de': return `[AnnexEvidence Error] Kein Element vom Typ "${t}" mit der ID "${i}" gefunden`;
        case 'zh-Hans': return `[AnnexEvidence Error] 未找到 ID 为 "${i}" 的 "${t}" 类型元素`;
        default: return `[AnnexEvidence Error] No se encontró elemento de tipo "${t}" con ID "${i}"`;
      }
    };
    return (
      <div className={styles.error}>
        {getErrorMsg(lang, type, id)}
      </div>
    );
  }

  // Determine container class based on level
  const containerClass = [
    styles.container,
    level === 1 ? styles.level1 : '',
    level === 2 ? styles.level2 : '',
    level === 3 ? styles.level3 : '',
  ].filter(Boolean).join(' ');

  return (
    <div className={containerClass}>
      {level <= 2 && CHIPS[level] && (
        <div className={styles[`chip${level}`]}>
          <span className={styles.chipSymbol} aria-hidden="true">{CHIPS[level].symbol}</span>
          <span className={styles.chipLabel}>{CHIPS[level].label}</span>
        </div>
      )}
      <AnnexEvidenceViewer type={type} item={item} lang={lang} />
    </div>
  );
}

```

```css
.container {
  margin: 1.5rem 0;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
}

.level1 {
  border-left: 3px solid #6B1024;
  padding-left: 1rem;
  background-color: var(--fig-surface, rgba(107, 16, 36, 0.02));
  border-radius: 0 8px 8px 0;
}

html[data-theme='dark'] .level1 {
  background-color: rgba(107, 16, 36, 0.05);
}

.level2 {
  border-left: none;
  padding-left: 0;
  background-color: transparent;
}

.level3 {
  border-left: none;
  padding-left: 0;
  background-color: transparent;
}

.error {
  padding: 1rem;
  color: #721c24;
  background-color: #f8d7da;
  border: 1px solid #f5c6cb;
  border-radius: 4px;
  margin: 1rem 0;
  font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif;
  font-size: 0.9rem;
}

/* ── Chips ── */
.chip1, .chip2 {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.35rem;
  font-size: 0.60rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.10em;
  padding: 0.25rem 0.65rem;
  border-radius: 3px;
  margin-bottom: 0.75rem;
  width: fit-content;
}
.chip1 { background: #6B1024; color: #fff; }
```

--- FILE: src/components/annex/AnnexEvidenceNav.jsx ---
```javascript
/**
 * AnnexEvidenceNav.jsx
 *
 * Navegación interna de un anexo conceptual.
 * Muestra 4 botones (Figuras · Tablas · Interactivos · Series) que hacen
 * scroll suave a la sección correspondiente dentro del mismo anexo.
 *
 * No navega a rutas externas. No abre anexos legacy.
 * Usa scrollIntoView — funciona solo en el cliente (SSR-safe).
 *
 * Props:
 *   items   { label: string, target: string }[]
 *           label  — texto del botón ('Figuras', 'Tablas', …)
 *           target — id del elemento DOM al que hace scroll
 *
 * Ejemplo:
 *   <AnnexEvidenceNav
 *     items={[
 *       { label: 'Figuras',       target: 'figuras-t1' },
 *       { label: 'Tablas',        target: 'tablas-t1'  },
 *       { label: 'Interactivos',  target: 'interactivos-t1' },
 *       { label: 'Series',        target: 'series-t1'  },
 *     ]}
 *   />
 */

import React from 'react';
import { useDocLang } from '@site/src/hooks/useDocLang';
import styles from './AnnexEvidenceNav.module.css';

const TYPE_ICONS = {
  Figuras: (
    <svg width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round">
      <rect x="3" y="3" width="18" height="18" rx="2" ry="2" />
      <circle cx="8.5" cy="8.5" r="1.5" />
      <polyline points="21 15 16 10 5 21" />
    </svg>
  ),
  Tablas: (
    <svg width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round">
      <rect x="3" y="3" width="18" height="18" rx="2" ry="2" />
      <line x1="3" y1="9" x2="21" y2="9" />
      <line x1="3" y1="15" x2="21" y2="15" />
      <line x1="9" y1="9" x2="9" y2="21" />
      <line x1="15" y1="9" x2="15" y2="21" />
    </svg>
  ),
  Interactivos: (
    <svg width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round">
      <circle cx="12" cy="12" r="3" />
      <line x1="3" y1="12" x2="9" y2="12" />
      <line x1="15" y1="12" x2="21" y2="12" />
      <line x1="12" y1="3" x2="12" y2="9" />
      <line x1="12" y1="15" x2="12" y2="21" />
    </svg>
  ),
  Series: (
    <svg width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round">
      <polyline points="22 12 18 12 15 21 9 3 6 12 2 12" />
    </svg>
  ),
};

function scrollToSection(targetId) {
  if (typeof document === 'undefined') return;
  const el = document.getElementById(targetId);
  if (!el) return;
  el.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'start' });
}

export default function AnnexEvidenceNav({ items = [] }) {
  const lang = useDocLang();
  if (!items.length) return null;

  const getNavLabel = (l) => {
    switch (l) {
      case 'en': return 'Explore evidence';
      case 'de': return 'Nachweise erkunden';
      case 'zh-Hans': return '浏览证据';
      default: return 'Explorar evidencias';
    }
  };

  const getAriaLabel = (l, label) => {
    switch (l) {
      case 'en': return `Go to section ${label}`;
      case 'de': return `Gehe zu Bereich ${label}`;
      case 'zh-Hans': return `前往 ${label} 部分`;
      default: return `Ir a sección de ${label}`;
    }
  };

  const getNavAriaLabel = (l) => {
    switch (l) {
      case 'en': return 'Annex section navigation';
      case 'de': return 'Navigation der Anhangsabschnitte';
      case 'zh-Hans': return '附录章节导航';
      default: return 'Navegación de secciones del anexo';
    }
  };

  return (
    <nav className={styles.navWrapper} aria-label={getNavAriaLabel(lang)}>
      <span className={styles.navLabel}>{getNavLabel(lang)}</span>
      <div className={styles.navButtons}>
        {items.map(({ label, target }) => {
          const icon = TYPE_ICONS[label] || null;
          return (
            <button
              key={target}
              type="button"
              className={styles.navBtn}
              aria-label={getAriaLabel(lang, label)}
              onClick={() => scrollToSection(target)}
            >
              <span className={styles.navBtnIcon} aria-hidden="true">{icon}</span>
              <span className={styles.navBtnLabel}>{label}</span>
            </button>
          );
        })}
      </div>
    </nav>
  );
}

```

```css
/* AnnexEvidenceNav.module.css
   Navegación interna de anexo — estética de índice académico.
   Variables scoped al .navWrapper.
   Sin neón. Sin dashboard.
*/

.navWrapper {
  /* Light mode */
  --nav-bg:        #f5f3ee;
  --nav-border:    #dedad4;
  --nav-text:      #3a342a;
  --nav-muted:     #625c52;
  --nav-accent:    #145c63;
  --nav-btn-bg:    #fdfbf7;
  --nav-btn-hover: #e8f4f5;
  --nav-btn-active:#145c63;
  --nav-btn-active-text: #ffffff;

  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 1rem;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  background: var(--nav-bg);
  border: 1px solid var(--nav-border);
  border-radius: 8px;
  padding: 0.7rem 1.1rem;
  margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
}

html[data-theme='dark'] .navWrapper {
  --nav-bg:        #0f1825;
  --nav-border:    rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.15);
  --nav-text:      #e2e8f0;
  --nav-muted:     #94a3b8;
  --nav-accent:    #83bdc2;
  --nav-btn-bg:    #0d1117;
  --nav-btn-hover: rgba(131, 189, 194, 0.1);
  --nav-btn-active:#1e6b71;
  --nav-btn-active-text: #f0f4f8;
}

.navLabel {
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.08em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--nav-muted);
  white-space: nowrap;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

.navButtons {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 0.5rem;
}

.navBtn {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.35rem;
  padding: 0.35rem 0.85rem;
  background: var(--nav-btn-bg);
  color: var(--nav-accent);
  border: 1px solid var(--nav-border);
  border-radius: 5px;
  font-size: 0.8rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition:
    background-color 0.15s ease,
    border-color 0.15s ease,
    color 0.15s ease;
  line-height: 1.4;
  letter-spacing: 0.01em;
}

.navBtn:hover {
  background-color: var(--nav-btn-hover);
  border-color: var(--nav-accent);
}

.navBtn:focus-visible {
  outline: 2px solid var(--nav-accent);
  outline-offset: 2px;
}

.navBtn:active {
  background-color: var(--nav-btn-active);
  border-color: var(--nav-btn-active);
  color: var(--nav-btn-active-text);
}

.navBtnIcon {
  font-size: 0.85em;
  line-height: 1;
}

.navBtnLabel {
  /* label text — no extra styles needed */
}

/* ── Responsive ──────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

@media (max-width: 640px) {
  .navWrapper {
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: flex-start;
    gap: 0.65rem;
    padding: 0.7rem 0.85rem;
  }

  .navButtons {
    width: 100%;
  }

  .navBtn {
    flex: 1;
    justify-content: center;
    min-width: 100px;
  }
}
```

--- FILE: src/components/annex/AnnexEvidenceViewer.jsx ---
```javascript
/**
 * AnnexEvidenceViewer.jsx
 *
 * Patrón: tarjeta compacta en la grid del anexo → botón → overlay fullscreen
 * via createPortal(content, document.body).
 *
 * Props:
 *   type   'figure' | 'table' | 'interactive' | 'chart'
 *   item   objeto de evidencia (imageGalleryData / forensicCategories / graphicsData / CHARTS)
 *   lang   locale string ('es' | 'en' | 'de' | 'zh-Hans')
 */

import React, { useState, useEffect, lazy, Suspense } from 'react';
import { createPortal } from 'react-dom';
import BrowserOnly from '@docusaurus/BrowserOnly';
import styles from './AnnexEvidenceViewer.module.css';

// ChartViewer se carga sólo cuando el usuario abre una gráfica
const ChartViewerLazy = lazy(() =>
  import(/* webpackChunkName: "annex-chart-viewer" */ '../ForensicGallery2/ChartViewer')
);

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Diccionario de traducciones
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

const TRANSLATIONS = {
  es: {
    figure: 'Figura',
    table: 'Tabla',
    interactive: 'Interactivo',
    chart: 'Serie',
    close: 'Cerrar',
    enlarge: 'Ampliar',
    enlargeFig: 'Ampliar figura',
    viewFullTable: 'Ver tabla completa',
    viewChart: 'Ver gráfica',
    openInteractive: 'Abrir interactivo',
    rows: 'filas',
    cols: 'col.',
    source: 'Fuente',
    note: 'Nota',
    loading: 'Cargando…',
    loadingChart: 'Cargando gráfica…',
    starting: 'Iniciando',
    noTableData: 'Datos de tabla no disponibles.',
  },
  en: {
    figure: 'Figure',
    table: 'Table',
    interactive: 'Interactive',
    chart: 'Series',
    close: 'Close',
    enlarge: 'Enlarge',
    enlargeFig: 'Enlarge figure',
    viewFullTable: 'View full table',
    viewChart: 'View chart',
    openInteractive: 'Open interactive',
    rows: 'rows',
    cols: 'col.',
    source: 'Source',
    note: 'Note',
    loading: 'Loading…',
    loadingChart: 'Loading chart…',
    starting: 'Starting',
    noTableData: 'Table data not available.',
  },
  de: {
    figure: 'Abbildung',
    table: 'Tabelle',
    interactive: 'Interaktiver Inhalt',
    chart: 'Zeitreihe',
    close: 'Schließen',
    enlarge: 'Vergrößern',
    enlargeFig: 'Abbildung vergrößern',
    viewFullTable: 'Ganze Tabelle anzeigen',
    viewChart: 'Grafik anzeigen',
    openInteractive: 'Interaktiven Inhalt öffnen',
    rows: 'Zeilen',
    cols: 'Sp.',
    source: 'Quelle',
    note: 'Hinweis',
    loading: 'Wird geladen…',
    loadingChart: 'Grafik wird geladen…',
    starting: 'Wird gestartet',
    noTableData: 'Tabellendaten nicht verfügbar.',
  },
  'zh-Hans': {
    figure: '图',
    table: '表',
    interactive: '互动模块',
    chart: '时间序列',
    close: '关闭',
    enlarge: '放大',
    enlargeFig: '放大图片',
    viewFullTable: '查看完整表格',
    viewChart: '查看图表',
    openInteractive: '打开互动模块',
    rows: '行',
    cols: '列',
    source: '来源',
    note: '备注',
    loading: '加载中…',
    loadingChart: '图表加载中…',
    starting: '正在启动',
    noTableData: '表格数据不可用。',
  }
};

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Helpers de columna — las tablas de forensic_categories usan {key, label}
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

const getColKey   = (col) => (typeof col === 'string' ? col : col.key);
const getColLabel = (col) => (typeof col === 'string' ? col : (col.label || col.key));

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Helpers de figura
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

function getFigureTitle(item, lang) {
  const lookupLang = lang === 'zh-Hans' ? 'zh' : lang;
  const t = item[`title_${lookupLang}`] || item[`title_${lang}`] || item.title_es || item.title || '';
  if (t) return t;
  const cap = item[`caption_${lookupLang}`] || item[`caption_${lang}`] || item.caption_es || item.caption_en || '';
  if (cap) {
    const first = cap.split(/[.!?]/)[0].trim();
    if (first) return first;
  }
  const defaultLabel = TRANSLATIONS[lang]?.figure || TRANSLATIONS.es.figure;
  return item.src
    ? item.src.split('/').pop().split('.')[0].replace(/[-_]/g, ' ')
    : defaultLabel;
}

function getFigureCaption(item, lang) {
  const lookupLang = lang === 'zh-Hans' ? 'zh' : lang;
  return item[`caption_${lookupLang}`] || item[`caption_${lang}`] || item.caption_es || item.caption_en || '';
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// FULLSCREEN MODAL — createPortal a document.body
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

function FullscreenEvidenceModal({ open, title, type, onClose, wide = false, lang, children }) {
  // Bloquear scroll del body mientras el modal está abierto
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!open) return;
    const prev = document.body.style.overflow;
    document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
    return () => {
      document.body.style.overflow = prev || '';
    };
  }, [open]);

  // Cerrar con Escape
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!open) return;
    const onKey = (e) => { if (e.key === 'Escape') onClose(); };
    document.addEventListener('keydown', onKey);
    return () => document.removeEventListener('keydown', onKey);
  }, [open, onClose]);

  // No renderizar en SSR ni cuando está cerrado
  if (!open) return null;
  if (typeof document === 'undefined') return null;

  const t = TRANSLATIONS[lang] || TRANSLATIONS.es;
  const label = t[type] || '';
  const shellClass = [
    styles.fsShell,
    type === 'figure' ? styles.fsShellFigure : '',
  ].filter(Boolean).join(' ');

  return createPortal(
    <div
      role="dialog"
      aria-modal="true"
      aria-labelledby="aev-fs-title"
      className={styles.fsBackdrop}
      onClick={(e) => { if (e.target === e.currentTarget) onClose(); }}
    >
      <div className={shellClass}>
        {/* ── CABECERA ────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */}
        <div className={styles.fsHeader}>
          <div className={styles.fsTitleGroup}>
            <span className={`${styles.fsBadge} ${styles[type]}`}>{label}</span>
            <span id="aev-fs-title" className={styles.fsModalTitle}>{title}</span>
          </div>
          <button
            type="button"
            className={styles.fsClose}
            onClick={onClose}
            aria-label={t.close}
          >
            ×
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* ── CUERPO ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */}
        <div className={wide ? styles.fsBodyWide : styles.fsBody}>
          {children}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>,
    document.body
  );
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// FIGURA — tarjeta compacta + modal fullscreen con imagen
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

function FigureViewer({ item, lang }) {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const title   = getFigureTitle(item, lang);
  const caption = getFigureCaption(item, lang);
  const t = TRANSLATIONS[lang] || TRANSLATIONS.es;
  
  let desc = caption;
  if (desc.startsWith(title)) {
    desc = desc.substring(title.length).trim().replace(/^[. -:]+/, '').trim();
  }
  const shortCap = desc.length > 150
    ? desc.slice(0, 147) + '…'
    : desc;

  const id = `fig-${item.src.split('/').pop().replace(/\.[^/.]+$/, "")}`;
  return (
    <div id={id} className={styles.card}>
      <div className={styles.badgeRow}>
        <span className={`${styles.badge} ${styles.figura}`}>{t.figure}</span>
      </div>

      {item.src && (
        <button
          type="button"
          className={styles.thumbnailBtn}
          onClick={() => setOpen(true)}
          aria-label={`${t.enlarge}: ${title}`}
        >
          <img
            src={item.src}
            alt={title}
            className={styles.thumbnail}
            loading="lazy"
          />
        </button>
      )}

      <h4 className={styles.cardTitle}>{title}</h4>
      {shortCap && <p className={styles.cardCaption}>{shortCap}</p>}

      <div className={styles.cardFooter}>
        <button
          type="button"
          className={styles.actionBtn}
          onClick={() => setOpen(true)}
        >
          {t.enlargeFig}
        </button>
      </div>

      <FullscreenEvidenceModal
        open={open}
        title={title}
        type="figure"
        lang={lang}
        onClose={() => setOpen(false)}
      >
        <div className={styles.figureContent}>
          <img src={item.src} alt={title} className={styles.figureImg} />
          {caption && (
            <p className={styles.figureCaption}>{caption}</p>
          )}
        </div>
      </FullscreenEvidenceModal>
    </div>
  );
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// TABLA — tarjeta compacta + modal fullscreen con tabla completa
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

function TableViewer({ item, lang }) {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const t = TRANSLATIONS[lang] || TRANSLATIONS.es;
  const title     = item.name || t.table;
  const note      = item.note || '';
  const shortNote = note.length > 130 ? note.slice(0, 127) + '…' : note;
  const rowCount  = Array.isArray(item.data)    ? item.data.length    : 0;
  const colCount  = Array.isArray(item.columns) ? item.columns.length : 0;

  const id = `tabla-${item.id}`;
  return (
    <div id={id} className={styles.card}>
      <div className={styles.badgeRow}>
        <span className={`${styles.badge} ${styles.tabla}`}>{t.table}</span>
      </div>

      <h4 className={styles.cardTitle}>{title}</h4>
      {shortNote && <p className={styles.cardCaption}>{shortNote}</p>}

      <div className={styles.cardMeta}>
        {rowCount > 0 && colCount > 0 && (
          <span className={styles.metaPill}>
            {rowCount} {t.rows} · {colCount} {t.cols}
          </span>
        )}
      </div>

      {item.source && (
        <p className={styles.cardSource}>{t.source}: {item.source}</p>
      )}

      <div className={styles.cardFooter}>
        <button
          type="button"
          className={styles.actionBtn}
          onClick={() => setOpen(true)}
        >
          {t.viewFullTable}
        </button>
      </div>

      <FullscreenEvidenceModal
        open={open}
        title={title}
        type="table"
        lang={lang}
        onClose={() => setOpen(false)}
      >
        <div className={styles.tableContent}>
          {item.columns && item.data ? (
            <div className={styles.tableScrollWrap}>
              <table className={styles.tableEl}>
                <thead>
                  <tr>
                    {item.columns.map((col, i) => (
                      <th key={i} className={styles.th}>
                        {getColLabel(col)}
                      </th>
                    ))}
                  </tr>
                </thead>
                <tbody>
                  {item.data.map((row, ri) => (
                    <tr
                      key={ri}
                      className={ri % 2 === 0 ? styles.trEven : styles.trOdd}
                    >
                      {item.columns.map((col, ci) => {
                        const key   = getColKey(col);
                        const label = getColLabel(col);
                        const val =
                          row[key] ??
                          row[label] ??
                          row[Object.keys(row)[ci]] ??
                          '—';
                        return (
                          <td key={ci} className={styles.td}>
                            {String(val)}
                          </td>
                        );
                      })}
                    </tr>
                  ))}
                </tbody>
              </table>
            </div>
          ) : (
            <p className={styles.fsEmptyMsg}>{t.noTableData}</p>
          )}

          {(note || item.source) && (
            <div className={styles.tableFooterMeta}>
              {note && (
                <p className={styles.tableFootnote}>
                  <em>{t.note}:</em> {note}
                </p>
              )}
              {item.source && (
                <p className={styles.tableFootnote}>
                  <em>{t.source}:</em> {item.source}
                </p>
              )}
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </FullscreenEvidenceModal>
    </div>
  );
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// INTERACTIVO — tarjeta compacta + modal fullscreen ancho
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

function InteractiveViewer({ item, lang }) {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const DynComponent = item.component;
  const t = TRANSLATIONS[lang] || TRANSLATIONS.es;

  const id = `grafico-${item.id}`;
  return (
    <div id={id} className={styles.card}>
      <div className={styles.badgeRow}>
        <span className={`${styles.badge} ${styles.interactivo}`}>
          {t.interactive}
        </span>
      </div>

      <h4 className={styles.cardTitle}>{item.title || item.id}</h4>
      {item.description && (
        <p className={styles.cardCaption}>{item.description}</p>
      )}

      <div className={styles.cardFooter}>
        <button
          type="button"
          className={styles.actionBtn}
          onClick={() => setOpen(true)}
        >
          {t.openInteractive}
        </button>
      </div>

      <FullscreenEvidenceModal
        open={open}
        title={item.title || item.id}
        type="interactive"
        wide={true}
        lang={lang}
        onClose={() => setOpen(false)}
      >
        <BrowserOnly
          fallback={<div className={styles.fsLoadingMsg}>{t.loading}</div>}
        >
          {() => (
            <Suspense
              fallback={
                <div className={styles.fsLoadingMsg}>
                  {t.starting} {item.title}…
                </div>
              }
            >
              <DynComponent lang={lang} isGallery={false} />
            </Suspense>
          )}
        </BrowserOnly>
      </FullscreenEvidenceModal>
    </div>
  );
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// SERIE (CHART) — tarjeta compacta + modal fullscreen con ChartViewer
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

function ChartSeriesViewer({ item, lang }) {
  const [open, setOpen]         = useState(false);
  const [currentId, setCurrentId] = useState(item.id);
  const t = TRANSLATIONS[lang] || TRANSLATIONS.es;

  const handleOpen = () => {
    setCurrentId(item.id); // reiniciar al chart original al abrir
    setOpen(true);
  };

  const id = item.id;
  return (
    <div id={id} className={styles.card}>
      <div className={styles.badgeRow}>
        <span className={`${styles.badge} ${styles.serie}`}>{t.chart}</span>
      </div>

      <h4 className={styles.cardTitle}>{item.title || `${t.chart} ${item.id}`}</h4>
      {item.subtitle && (
        <p className={styles.cardCaption}>{item.subtitle}</p>
      )}
      {(item.sourceBadge || item.source) && (
        <p className={styles.cardSource}>
          {t.source}: {item.sourceBadge || item.source}
        </p>
      )}

      <div className={styles.cardFooter}>
        <button
          type="button"
          className={styles.actionBtn}
          onClick={handleOpen}
        >
          {t.viewChart}
        </button>
      </div>

      <FullscreenEvidenceModal
        open={open}
        title={item.title || `${t.chart} ${item.id}`}
        type="chart"
        wide={true}
        lang={lang}
        onClose={() => setOpen(false)}
      >
        <BrowserOnly
          fallback={<div className={styles.fsLoadingMsg}>{t.loadingChart}</div>}
        >
          {() => (
            <Suspense
              fallback={
                <div className={styles.fsLoadingMsg}>
                  {t.starting} {item.title}…
                </div>
              }
            >
              <ChartViewerLazy
                chartId={currentId}
                locale={lang}
                onSelectChart={setCurrentId}
              />
            </Suspense>
          )}
        </BrowserOnly>
      </FullscreenEvidenceModal>
    </div>
  );
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// MAIN EXPORT
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export default function AnnexEvidenceViewer({ type, item, lang = 'es' }) {
  if (!item) return null;

  switch (type) {
    case 'figure':
      return <FigureViewer item={item} lang={lang} />;
    case 'table':
      return <TableViewer item={item} lang={lang} />;
    case 'interactive':
      return <InteractiveViewer item={item} lang={lang} />;
    case 'chart':
      return <ChartSeriesViewer item={item} lang={lang} />;
    default:
      return null;
  }
}
```
